text.p: NIPSCO Industries Inc and IWC Resources Corp said Tuesday they completed their merger after IWC shareholders approved the deal with about 97 percent in favor.
Under the deal announced last December, NIPSCO acquired IWC stock for about $290 million.
IWC is now a wholly owned subsidiary of NIPSCO. IWC and its units will continue to operate with local management, employees and directors, the companies said.
Hammond, Ind.-based NIPSCO is an energy/utility holding company whose regulated subsidiaries provide natural gas and electric services in northern Indiana.
IWC's largest subsidiary, Indianapolis Water Co, provides water and related services to about 235,000 customers in the Indianapolis area.
